ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-01.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-01.body:
The angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$: $10x=360$, so $x=36$ and the largest angle is $4x=144^\circ$.

**Answer: 144**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-02.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-02.body:
The larger is $(24+20)/2=22$ and the smaller is $(24-20)/2=2$. Product $=44$.

**Answer: 44**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-03.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-03.body:
Half of 240 is 120, a fifth is 24, a tenth is 2.40.

**Answer: £2.40**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-04.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-04.body:
The three shapes meet at a point with interior angles $108^\circ$ (pentagon), $90^\circ$ (square) and $60^\circ$ (triangle). Angles around a point sum to $360^\circ$, so $x=360-108-90-60=102$.

**Answer: 102**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-05.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-05.body:
$2024=2^3\times11\times23$, so the five primes are $2,2,2,11,23$ with sum $40$ and mean $8$.

**Answer: 8**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-06.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-06.body:
Let $\bullet=a$, $\square=b$, $\times=c$ and $\checkmark=d$. Row 1: $3a+b=11$. Row 4: $3b+a=9$. Solving: $a=3$, $b=2$. Column 1: $a+b+d+b=8$ gives $d=1$. Row 3: $3d+c=11$ gives $c=8$. The missing row is $\square,\times,\square,\checkmark$: $2+8+2+1=13$. (Check column 2: $a+c+c+b=3+8+8+2=21$.)

**Answer: 13**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-07.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-07.body:
The time from 29 February 2024 to 29 February 2028 is $4\times365+1=1461$ days $=208$ weeks and $5$ days. Thursday plus 5 days is Tuesday.

**Answer: Tuesday**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-09.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-09.body:
The sum of the first $n$ cubes is $(1+2+\dots+n)^2$. For $n=9$: $45^2=2025$.

**Answer: 2025**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-10.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-10.body:
The button has area $\pi$. Each hole has area $\pi/16$, so the four holes have area $\pi/4$. The fraction left is $1-\frac14=\frac34$.

**Answer: $\frac34$**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-11.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-11.body:
The sum is 25. Write them in order $a\le b\le5\le d\le e$ with $e-a=5$. The mode 5 needs another 5 among $b,d$. If $b=5$: $a+d+e=15$ with $a=e-5$ gives $2e+d=20$, $d\ge5$, so $e\le7$. If $d=5$: $a+b+e=15$ with $a=e-5$ gives $b=20-2e$; we need $a\le b\le5$, so $e\ge8$ ($b\le5$) and $e-5\le20-2e$ gives $e\le8$. So $e=8$: $3,4,5,5,8$ works (sum 25, median 5, mode 5, range 5).

**Answer: 8**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-12.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-12.body:
If the fourth vertex is opposite $P$ and the other two vertices are $Q,R$, it is $Q+R-P$. The three possibilities are $(8,4)+(18,4)-(10,1)=(16,7)$, $(10,1)+(18,4)-(8,4)=(20,1)$ and $(10,1)+(8,4)-(18,4)=(0,1)$. Their $x$-coordinates average $(16+20+0)/3=12$.

**Answer: 12**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-13.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-13.body:
At 8:24 the minute hand is at $24\times6=144^\circ$ from 12. The hour hand is at $8\times30+24\times0.5=252^\circ$. The difference is $108^\circ$.

**Answer: 108**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-14.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-14.body:
Adding the three equations: $(2-1+1)x+(1+2-1)y+(-1+1+2)z=48$, i.e. $2(x+y+z)=48$, so $x+y+z=24$.

**Answer: 24**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-15.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-15.body:
The train gains on the bus at $20-16=4$ m/s. It must gain $60+4=64$ m, taking $64\div4=16$ seconds.

**Answer: 16**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-16.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-16.body:
The square is between $167$ and $177$. The only square in that range is $169=13^2$.

**Answer: 13**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-17.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-17.body:
The fourth vertex is $Q+R-P$ for one of the three choices of $P$: opposite $(12,3)$ gives $(2,5)+(1,2)-(12,3)=(-9,4)$; opposite $(1,2)$ gives $(2,5)+(12,3)-(1,2)=(13,6)$; opposite $(2,5)$ gives $(1,2)+(12,3)-(2,5)=(11,0)$. Only $(13,6)$ has two positive coordinates.

**Answer: $(13,6)$**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-19.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-19.body:
If the two equal angles are both $x$: $3x+24=180$, so $x=52$. If the equal angles are both $x+24$: $3x+48=180$, so $x=44$. The difference is $8$.

**Answer: 8**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-20.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-20.body:
At each vertex of the pentagon the angles are $108^\circ$ (pentagon), $120^\circ$ and $120^\circ$ (two hexagons) and the gap $x^\circ$ between the hexagons. So $x=360-108-120-120=12$.

**Answer: 12**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-21.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-21.body:
The sum is 120. Write them in order $a\le b\le24\le d\le e$. To make the range large take $a$ small and $e$ large, with 24 twice (needed for the mode) as the median and one other value. Take $c=d=24$: $a+b+e=72$. If $a=b=1$ the mode would not be unique, so take $a=1,b=2$: $e=69$, giving range $68$. Putting 24 in other places forces $e$ to be smaller (e.g. $b=c=24$ gives $e\le47$).

**Answer: 68**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-22.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-22.body:
There are 25 numbers. Those not divisible by 2, 3 or 5 are $31,37,41,43,47,49,53$: 7 of them. $7/25=28\%$.

**Answer: 28**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-25.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-25.body:
Let $\checkmark=p$, $\times=q$, $\square=s$, $\bullet=r$. Row 3 and row 4: $r+3s=10$, $s+3r=6$, so $s=3$, $r=1$. Column 1: $2p+r+s=8$ gives $p=2$. Row 1: $3p+q=10$ gives $q=4$. The missing row is $\checkmark,\square,\times,\square$: $2+3+4+3=12$.

**Answer: 12**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-26.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-26.body:
At 12:20 the minute hand is at $20\times6=120^\circ$ and the hour hand has moved $20\times0.5=10^\circ$ past 12. The angle is $110^\circ$.

**Answer: 110**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-27.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-27.body:
Let the one-way distance be 15 km (any distance works). Up takes 5 h, down takes 3 h; total 30 km in 8 h, so the average speed is $30/8=3.75$ km/h.

**Answer: 3.75 km/h**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-29.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-29.body:
Let $S$ be the shaded fraction of a square. Splitting into four, two quarters are shaded and the fourth quarter repeats the pattern at a quarter of the size: $S=\frac12+\frac14S$. So $\frac34S=\frac12$ and $S=\frac23$.

**Answer: $\frac23$**

ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-30.title: Solution
ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-relay-30.body:
The cube has side 9 cm, so every edge of the cuboid is at most 9. $210=2\times3\times5\times7$; the only way to split it into three factors each at most 9 is $5\times6\times7$. The surface area is $2(5\cdot6+5\cdot7+6\cdot7)=2(30+35+42)=214$ cm$^2$.

**Answer: 214**
